newsitem.title: UK: EMI DOWN ON WORRIES OVER CLASSICAL CD SALES.
newsitem.headline: EMI DOWN ON WORRIES OVER CLASSICAL CD SALES.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group Plc fell on Wednesday as a report in the Daily Telegraph renewed jitters over the state of the music market and the stock continued to react to recent negative comment from Schroders, dealers said.
The stock was down 12p at 11.88 stg by 0935 GMT.
The Daily Telegraph reported static sales of classical CDs by PolyGram NV'S Deutsche Grammophon, the market leader.

"Wherever you turn this winter, the tale is one of massed retreat across the classical landscape," the Telegraph said. EMI remains sensitive to any suggestion of weak sales in the music market, traders said.
